product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving provides all-in-one booking, client management, payments, marketing, and AI tools for fitness, wellness, health, and beauty businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its target industries and its booking, client management, payments, marketing, and AI functionality.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists plans and prices, including Starter at $69 per month: https://www.wellnessliving.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The fitness software page explicitly identifies Advantage Personal Training and Cristini Athletics as customers: https://www.wellnessliving.com/fitness/software. | named_customers.0: Advantage Personal Training is explicitly identified as a customer. | named_customers.1: Cristini Athletics is explicitly identified as a customer.

employee_band.notes: The company LinkedIn profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company LinkedIn profile explicitly lists headquarters in Thornhill, Ontario. | hq_country: The headquarters address explicitly places WellnessLiving in Thornhill, Ontario, Canada: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/wellnessliving.

founded_year.notes: The company LinkedIn profile states 2012, consistent with its company-database profile. A 2022 company press release instead states 2013, so the founding year has conflicting published evidence.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents business-growth, marketing, customer-story, product, and release-note content, rather than a qualifying engineer-authored technical blog: https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes API onboarding and a developer portal, CAASI guidance, and a security-framework article, establishing several public articles rather than a single FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Solutions Engineer posting is a qualifying AI role and describes building AI workflows and customer-facing solutions: https://jobs.gohire.io/wellnessliving-zvcrxvet/ai-solutions-engineer-294353.

model_provider.notes: The public help-center article explicitly says CAASI is powered by Google Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security framework explicitly claims a SOC 2 Type 2 report, third-party HIPAA audits, and HIPAA-compliant software. AWS certifications and payment-processor attestations are not attributed to WellnessLiving. | compliance_certs.0: WellnessLiving explicitly offers its own SOC 2 Type 2 report. | compliance_certs.1: WellnessLiving explicitly claims HIPAA audits and HIPAA-compliant software.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest recorded equity round is classified as private equity, consistent with the investor's description of a minority investment. | funding_date: The latest recorded round and the investor announcement are dated August 16, 2022, giving 2022-08. | funding_amount_usd: The latest recorded private-equity round was $46 million. The investor announcement distinguishes this minority investment from concurrent $20 million debt financing; the combined financing package was $66 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding is from August 2022, before the 18-month window; the funding history shows no newer round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting is open for applications and dated November 9, 2026: https://jobs.gohire.io/wellnessliving-zvcrxvet/enterprise-account-executive-299157.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 28, 2026 announcement introduced general availability of CAASI Chat Agent and Phone Agent, a major launch within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jay Hedges's profile lists his WellnessLiving VP Sales position as starting in July 2026, within the 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/jayhedges.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The AI Development Lead posting explicitly names Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM integrations. This establishes a product-integration signal, not independent confirmation of its internal sales CRM: https://jobs.gohire.io/wellnessliving-zvcrxvet/ai-development-lead-257703. | crm_stack_signal.0: Salesforce is explicitly named as a CRM integration in the job posting. | crm_stack_signal.1: HubSpot is explicitly named as a CRM integration in the job posting.
